errors.evidence: The description expands the abbreviation HCI to Human Capital Index, but this information is not present in the figure itself, which only uses "HCI".
The value for 2014 is exactly halfway between 0.79 and 0.80, making it 0.795. Describing it as 'около 0,79' (around 0.79) is an inaccurate underestimate.
The value for 2016 is the minimum point on the graph, but it is visibly higher than 0.785, sitting just below the 0.79 line (approximately 0.788).
The value for 2018 is exactly halfway between 0.81 and 0.82, making it 0.815. Describing it as 'около 0,81' (around 0.81) is an inaccurate underestimate.
